name: plugin-engineering
description: Builds and maintains a public Claude Code plugin marketplace on GitHub from the official docs, distilled for plugins that third parties install: marketplaces, manifests, skills, agents, hooks, mods, MCP servers, settings, validation and releases, checked against the latest release notes. Includes the complete plugin CLI reference: every claude plugin and claude plugin marketplace subcommand, /plugin form and session flag, with exact flags, messages, JSON fields, exit codes and minimum versions.
